import random

p = 0.3

    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            adj[i][j] = 1
            adj[j][i] = 1

# Start with a random partition
partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)

# Greedy local search
def count_cut_edges(partition, adj):
    cut = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            if adj[i][j] == 1 and partition[i] != partition[j]:
                cut += 1
    return cut

# Improve partition using local search
max_iterations = 1000
best_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)

for iteration in range(max_iterations):
    improved = False
    for vertex in range(n):
        # Try flipping this vertex
        old_side = partition[vertex]
        partition[vertex] = 1 - old_side
        
        new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)
        
        if new_cut > best_cut:
            best_cut = new_cut
            improved = True
        else:
            # Revert the change
            partition[vertex] = old_side
    
    if not improved:

            new_cut = count_cut_edges(current_partition, adj)
            
            if new_cut > current_cut:
                improved = True
            else:
                current_partition[vertex] = old_side
        
        if not improved:
            break
    
    final_cut = count_cut_edges(current_partition, adj)
    if final_cut > best_cut:
        best_cut = final_cut
        best_partition = current_partition.copy()

import numpy as np
import random

# Generate the fixed G(200, 0.3) graph with seed=17
np.random.seed(17)
random.seed(17)

n = 200
p = 0.3

# Generate adjacency matrix
adj = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=int)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            adj[i][j] = 1
            adj[j][i] = 1

# Start with a random partition
partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)

# Local search improvement
def count_cut_edges(partition, adj):
    cut = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            if adj[i][j] == 1 and partition[i] != partition[j]:
                cut += 1
    return cut

# Greedy local search
improved = True
while improved:
    improved = False
    current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)
    
    for v in range(n):
        # Try flipping vertex v
        partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
        new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)
        
        if new_cut > current_cut:
            current_cut = new_cut
            improved = True
            break
        else:
            # Revert the flip
            partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]

# Run multiple restarts to find better solution
best_partition = partition.copy()
best_cut = count_cut_edges(best_partition, adj)

for restart in range(20):
    # Random restart
    partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)
    
    # Local search
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)
        
        for v in range(n):
            partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
            new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)
            
            if new_cut > current_cut:
                current_cut = new_cut
                improved = True
                break
            else:
                partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
    
    if current_cut > best_cut:
        best_cut = current_cut
        best_partition = partition.copy()
